findings.location: HTML paragraph beginning “People have told me…”; quoted reference Luke 2:52
findings.source_quote: “…in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man –Luke 2:52.”
findings.suggested_fix: Ganti kutipan di dalam tag <em> menjadi: “…dalam hikmat dan perawakan, serta dalam perkenanan Allah dan manusia –Lukas 2:52.”
findings.translation_quote: “…dalam hikmat dan pertumbuhan, serta dalam kasih Allah dan manusia –Lukas 2:52.”

findings.location: HTML paragraph beginning “A heart that has not been made new…”
findings.source_quote: “It is no wonder that many churches of today are accepting drift.”
findings.suggested_fix: Ganti “menerima kemerosotan” dengan “menerima penyimpangan” agar makna drift tetap merujuk pada penyimpangan, bukan sekadar kemunduran.
findings.translation_quote: “Tidak heran jika banyak gereja masa kini menerima kemerosotan.”
